_comment: Update policy for the Fuelo mobile app. minimum_version triggers a blocking modal (older clients are locked out). latest_version triggers a dismissible soft-update banner (older clients are nagged once per version). update_url is the destination — Play Store, App Store, or Firebase App Distribution tester URL while in beta. message_es is shown for the blocking modal; soft_update_message_es for the banner.
message_es: Esta versión de Fuelo ya no es compatible. Actualízala para seguir usándola.
soft_update_message_es: Hay una nueva versión de Fuelo con mejoras.
